summary: Contao is a PHP-based content management system designed for building websites and structured web applications. It provides the foundational tools required to manage digital content and publish pages from a central administration interface. Administrators can organise site architecture and template data within a standard web hosting environment.
goodFor: It suits developers and system administrators looking for a traditional PHP content management system to host client websites or internal publishing portals.
watchOut: The project has a modest community footprint compared to dominant alternatives, which may limit the availability of third-party modules and community-driven documentation.
deployNotes: As a PHP application, it typically requires a compatible web server like Apache or Nginx, alongside a relational database such as MySQL or MariaDB for persistent data storage.
